headlines.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Bill, Moriarty & Page made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20.
Back on this day in 2023, Mercedes Martinez stepped back through the curtain after a long-awaited absence after 13 months away, appearing on Rampage.

Back on this day in 2023, Max Caster reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Spanish Announce Project (Trio) on Rampage, rated 3.85 in a wild trios sprint.
